title: VIEW-002: page layout control in the GUI
acceptance: the bottom bar exposes a Page layout picker for Single Page, Continuous, Two Page and Two Page Continuous; choosing one dispatches SetViewMode and changes the active tab's layout; a widget test drives the real egui control; VIEW-002 becomes verified on the gui host.
notes: ADR 0009 row 5. The canvas layouts were real; the GUI had no control to select them.
